summary: Verified pricing-audit bug-fix bundle: (1) AddPropertyModal rental_type switch now clears stranded price field (root cause of ₪450/mo bug) — verified end-to-end via Playwright, (2) price-sanity-warning appears/hides correctly for low long-term (<₪1500) and high vacation (>₪5000) inputs, (3) backend GET /api/admin/properties/pricing-audit — auth (admin/owner/renter/anon), bucketing (zero_price/low_monthly/wrong_field), custom thresholds, (4) admin Listings tab audit banner (pricing-audit-banner + audit-zero-price/audit-low-monthly/audit-wrong-field sub-testids) — hidden when totals=0, visible when data present, (5) regression: /properties/check-duplicate placed before /properties/{id}, /properties/{id} still works, duplicates auto-resolve/resolve endpoints intact. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. Frontend: 1 critical import bug fixed in ListingsTab.jsx (useEffect was not imported, causing full crash of admin Listings tab).

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect was used (for priceAudit fetch) but not imported → 'useEffect is not defined' ReferenceError crashed the entire admin Listings tab on mount. FIXED by testing agent: added useEffect to React import on line 1.

action_items: None blocking. Main agent should verify the ListingsTab.jsx useEffect import fix (added by testing agent on line 1). Consider adding a lint rule / pre-commit check to catch missing React hook imports (this is at least the 2nd time this has surfaced).
critical_code_review_comments: ListingsTab.jsx missing useEffect import was a real production-blocking regression — the admin Listings tab would show a fatal red React error overlay in dev / a blank tab in prod. Recommend the main agent runs `eslint --rule 'react-hooks/rules-of-hooks: error'` or ensure the CI lint step catches missing imports.

The AddPropertyModal onChange handler at line 413 correctly clears the stranded price field on rental_type change — implementation is solid and matches the review request. price-sanity-warning at lines 727-753 uses computed value on every render (no state), so it stays consistent with the actual form value — no stale-state risk.

Backend pricing-audit endpoint has correct role guard (payload.get('role') != 'admin' → 403). Uses .find({}, projection).to_list(5000) — for a shop with >5000 properties this would silently truncate; consider paginating or streaming.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The pricing-audit + AddPropertyModal fix bundle is fully verified. The one bug found (missing useEffect import in ListingsTab.jsx) is already fixed. All 12 backend tests in test_pricing_audit.py pass. Note: tests/.env.test has TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD=Admin1234! but the actual admin password is Admin123! (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md and confirmed via curl login). Consider fixing tests/.env.test if this becomes an issue for other test suites.
rca of the issue: Original user-reported bug (impossibly low ₪78/₪450/₪630 monthly rents on admin listings): ROOT CAUSE was AddPropertyModal storing vacation nightly_price in form state, and when host switched rental_type back to long-term, the stranded nightly_price value stayed in state. On submit, both monthly_price='' and nightly_price=450 were sent. The existing admin 'Repair prices' tool then auto-migrated the stranded nightly to monthly_price (because long-term + nightly>0 + monthly=0 → move nightly→monthly) — producing the tiny bogus monthly values. FIX (verified): rental_type select onChange in AddPropertyModal.jsx line 413-433 now zeroes the stranded price field on rental-type crossover. Additionally, the new price-sanity-warning banner alerts hosts inline before submit, and the new /admin/properties/pricing-audit endpoint + banner in ListingsTab surfaces any remaining bad rows to admins.
